name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: Modal dialog on the native dialog element, with focus return and a described title.

keyboard: Cycles inside the dialog (the page behind is inert)
aria: aria-labelledby points at the title, aria-describedby at the description
The close icon button has aria-label="Close"
showModal() makes the page inert and implies aria-modal
Focus moves to [data-autofocus], else the first control of the body or footer, and returns to the opener on close
a11y.notes: Use data-autofocus (not React's autoFocus) to choose the first focused control. For destructive confirmations, focus the safe action. Backdrop click is off by default.
